approach: Retroactive plan: the feature already shipped via PR 1139, ported via 1334, refined by 1556 and 1603. Documented the as-shipped architecture (draftPersistence.ts consolidated engine, draftId-scoped server store, MyKeyboardsList.tsx UI) against the spec's requirements rather than designing new work.

decisions.decision: Treat spec 072 as retroactive verification rather than new design work
decisions.why: Three parallel codebase investigations confirmed every user story (index/reconcile, resume, pre-index adoption, submission recording, delete) and the full server draftId/status/prUrl model are already implemented and shipped, cited directly by spec number in ManagedPRSubmitPanel.tsx
decisions.rejected: Producing a forward-looking implementation plan as if this were greenfield work, which would risk proposing changes that regress the shipped composite-key migration or list-endpoint branching

decisions.decision: Corrected the local autosave debounce claim (1s to 500ms) as a documentation-only fix, not a behavior change
decisions.why: The 1s figure was accurate for the now-retired draftAutosave.ts module before commit 215ede33 consolidated it into draftPersistence.ts, which uses 500ms; the cloud figure (20s) still matches
decisions.rejected: Changing the shipped debounce value to match the spec text, which would be an unrequested behavior change with no problem to solve

decisions.decision: Journaled all 27 verification tasks through the write-context.py script (append plus materialize) rather than leaving the hand-authored tasks.md checkboxes as the only record
decisions.why: The Companion protocol reserves checkbox ownership to the script; hand-editing was a shortcut taken when first drafting tasks.md and was corrected in the same pass before mark-complete
decisions.rejected: Leaving the hand-written checkboxes unjournaled, which would mean no task_summaries evidence for the Activity panel

plan.summary: Documented the as-shipped My Keyboards architecture (client draft engine, server draftId model, UI) against spec 072 requirements; found the feature fully implemented with one doc-only drift (debounce value).
plan.key_finding: Spec 072 is the renumbered survivor of the original specs/037-my-keyboards spec whose implementation (PR 1139/1334/1556/1603) already shipped; this is retroactive verification, not new design.

implement.summary: Retroactively verified spec 072 (My Keyboards) is fully implemented and shipped via PR 1139/1334/1556/1603; corrected two documentation drifts in spec.md (debounce value, putDraft signature); live-verified oauth-backend fully green and studio partially green (blocked by a pre-existing local Node26/jsdom issue, not a regression).
